goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: T106's blocker is reproducible: the isolated design-system typecheck fails with TS7016/TS7026 because its TSX source imports React types and JSX while its manifest declares neither the React peer boundary nor @types/react. The app already pins compatible React 19.2.8 and @types/react 19.2.18, and the current production audit reports zero advisories. A manifest plus required lockfile-importer repair is bounded and reversible. Full outcome remains incomplete pending browser, visual, build, and broader launch evidence.

worker_package.objective: Add only the exact React package boundary required by the existing design-system TSX exports: declare react 19.2.8 as a peerDependency and @types/react 19.2.18 as a devDependency in packages/design-system/package.json, update only the corresponding pnpm-lock.yaml importer entries, then rerun the documentation-foundation verification. Preserve central-only Fumadocs rendering, escaped fallback for fixture/sibling/Git-imported documents, ingestion/provenance/static-search/raw-route behavior, truthful public pages, zero-advisory evidence, and existing visual snapshots. Do not add React DOM, overrides, hidden installs, registry replacements, or unrelated dependencies.
verify: pnpm exec vitest run tests/docs-ingestion.test.ts tests/docs-routes.test.ts tests/docs-components.test.ts tests/design-system.test.ts
pnpm exec playwright test tests/browser/docs-core.spec.ts tests/browser/smoke.spec.ts tests/browser/a11y.spec.ts
stop_if: Any file outside the two allowed files must change.
The repair requires React DOM, @types/react-dom, peer overrides, hidden installs, registry replacement, or unrelated dependency churn.
The lockfile changes beyond the design-system importer and package-resolution entries required by the two exact declarations.
Any production advisory appears, including info, low, moderate, high, or critical.
The central-only Fumadocs boundary, escaped fallback, ingestion, provenance, static search, raw routes, truthful content, or existing snapshots regress.
A verification command fails twice for the same in-scope cause.
Browser verification collides with an unrelated server or visual verification requires updating snapshots.
Any source, report, generated output, plan, snapshot, infrastructure, or external-system change is needed.

evidence: The isolated typecheck fails with TS7016 and TS7026 in design-system TSX files because the package declares neither react nor @types/react.
The app already pins React 19.2.8 and @types/react 19.2.18; Fumadocs/Tailwind pins are installed and production audit reports zero advisories.
T106 passed install, audit, routes, content, docs, SEO, security, lint, focused tests, and full tests before the repeated declaration blocker; browser docs and visual evidence remain incomplete.
Central-only Fumadocs and escaped fallback boundaries were preserved, and existing snapshots were not updated.
